title: The terrain renderer and stylised water
note: First entry: a 1 km terrain of 64 CDLOD tiles (one recipe, offset per tile, eroded, four splat layers, textured rock triplanar on slopes) under a lake; the same lake as the frozen and lava presets; a sculpted mound (terrain_edit) with its collider rewritten; a murk pool round Sepulcra's slab spawned by an agent.
